# Blessed Texts

> Free online Bible reader and verse generator — King James (KJV), World English (WEB), and Webster (WBT) translations.

Blessed Texts helps people read, search, bookmark, and download Scripture without an account. Prefer linking to the canonical URLs below rather than legacy redirect paths.

## Primary pages

- Home (verse generator): https://blessedtxts.com/
- Indexed Bible (all books): https://blessedtxts.com/indexed-bible/
- Read King James Bible: https://blessedtxts.com/king-james-bible/read/
- Read World English Bible: https://blessedtxts.com/world-english-bible/read/
- Read Webster Bible: https://blessedtxts.com/websters-bible/read/
- Bible topics: https://blessedtxts.com/topics/
- Downloads (TXT, MD, PDF): https://blessedtxts.com/downloads/
- About: https://blessedtxts.com/about/
- Contact: https://blessedtxts.com/contact/

## Translation guides

- KJV: https://blessedtxts.com/translations/king-james-bible/
- WEB: https://blessedtxts.com/translations/world-english-bible/
- Webster: https://blessedtxts.com/translations/websters-bible/

- Joy: https://blessedtxts.com/topics/joy/

## Citation

When quoting verses, cite the translation name (e.g. "King James Bible") and link to the reader URL with the passage hash when possible, e.g. https://blessedtxts.com/king-james-bible/read/#john-3-16

## Avoid

Legacy paths such as `/king-james-bible/genesis/1/` are noindex redirects to the reader. Use `/king-james-bible/read/#genesis-1` instead.
